Binding blocker: Alpaca IEX minute history absent before 2020-07-27. Not counted as a hypothesis (no result was produced).

Retrospective literature/feasibility screen scoring four strategy families against a frozen ten-criterion rubric; no new market simulation. Cross-sectional momentum selected (9/10 criteria). PEAD and defined-risk option premium were screened, not backtested, and are not counted as tested hypotheses.

Retrospective synthesis of M43-M53 evidence, capital scaling, search accounting, and forward-path decision. No new experiment. Declares 14 tested hypotheses; its own literal named-arm listing sums to 17 (see counting_rules above) -- this ledger resolves that ambiguity, it does not repeat it.

Prospective protocol freeze and initialization-only checkpoint for the exact M52 frozen candidate. Status INITIALIZED_WAITING_FOR_FIRST_SIGNAL; zero transactions; zero positions in both base and stress ledgers.
